description: Create a one-time CI runner registration token for an owner (your username, an org you own or admin, or 'platform' as a site admin). A runner started with RUNNER_REGISTRATION_TOKEN=<token> registers once and gets its own long-lived credential; that owner's CI then runs on it. Expires in an hour. Returns {owner, token, expiresAt, gluecronUrl}.

labels.description: Comma-separated labels the runner gets in addition to its own (e.g. gpu,arm64)

name: gluecron_create_runner_registration_token
